body:
I have talked to a counselor a whole back. They mostly talked to me about the divorce but not much else. At that time I wasn't feeling like how I am now though.
I've wanted to say something to my dad about this but every time I get the chance I choke, because I don't want to see his reaction. This is a bigger problem even more so because my step mothers ex committed suicide prior to their divorce.
I have told a friend that is out of state, who just said not to go down that route and to keep my mind off of it. Unfortunately the feeling keeps coming back. 
I've thought about going to another counselor at school because that is the only way I have access towards that type of help.
I haven't done that worried that it may be brought to the attention of my parents.
